subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should `AgentToolResult.control` plus `yieldToolResult(...)` become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for plugin-owned turn handoff?
rationale: This is a new third-party API and host-runtime control seam; implementation correctness cannot decide whether this is the long-term supported boundary.

options.title: Approve after catalog repair
options.body: Accept the result-control SDK design once sequential scheduling is preserved across both catalog surfaces and exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Retain host-level yield handling but replace the public result field with a narrower runtime capability or plugin API before merge.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer the PR if maintainers do not want plugins to control turn handoff through tool results.

recommendation.title: Approve after catalog repair
recommendation.body: Accept the result-control SDK design once sequential scheduling is preserved across both catalog surfaces and exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent-runtime extraction and embedded-runner ownership make this the strongest available routing candidate for the permanent SDK boundary.
